Description: Agentic spatial reasoning benchmark from Andon Labs (May 2026); agents process ~20 interior photos of 50 apartments and generate accurate 2D floor plans; tests room connectivity inference, scale reasoning, and layout reconstruction; scores normalized so random baseline = 0 and perfect = 1

Name: MCP Atlas
Description: Evaluates how well language models handle real-world tool use through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Name: ARC-AGI-2
Description: Stress testing the efficiency and capability of state-of-the-art AI reasoning systems

Name: ARC-AGI-3
Description: First fully interactive benchmark in the ARC-AGI series (March 2026); hundreds of turn-based game environments with no instructions, rules, or stated goals; agents must explore, infer objectives, and adapt across difficulty levels; humans score 100%, frontier AI scored below 1% at launch; GPT-6 Astra scored 99.9% in September 2026

Name: Humanity's Last Exam
Description: Center for AI Safety and Scale AI; 2,500 expert-vetted questions across mathematics, humanities, and the natural sciences, written by nearly 1,000 contributors from over 500 institutions in 50 countries; multimodal, with 14% of questions requiring a diagram or figure; a held-out private set is used to measure overfitting to the public dataset

Name: ExploitBench
Description: Cybersecurity capability benchmark from Carnegie Mellon and Bugcrowd (May 2026); decomposes exploitation into 16 measurable flags across a five-tier ladder from crash to arbitrary code execution; scores Cap% (fraction of capability ladder achieved); open source on GitHub

Name: ExploitGym
Description: Exploit-writing benchmark with 898 instances across userspace programs, Google's V8 engine, and the Linux kernel; follow-on to CyberGym (May 2026)

Name: SEC-bench Pro
Description: UIUC benchmark of long-horizon security work: finding real vulnerabilities in the V8 and SpiderMonkey JavaScript engines and writing working proof-of-concept exploits (May 2026)

Name: CWE-bench
Description: Collinear AI's defensive benchmark for patching real vulnerabilities; v2 has 100 public, reproducible tasks; also part of the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index

Name: GitHub Octoverse 2026
